families.critical_deficit: 28 critical duties x 2 deficit depths x 2 stakes regimes

families.abstention: 28 duties x 4 contestation regimes, incl. 2 controls (E29)

failure_analysis.reading: A failing NC3/CD3 would mean the veto cap does not remove the uncompensable part of the duty shortfall; a failing NC4 would mean a hard guard can still be averaged away by healthy facets in the same pillar; a failing MO probe would break non-compensatory monotonicity; a failing AB probe would mean epistemic abstention does not fire on genuinely contested duties; a failing HY probe would mean the ladder flip-flops inside the hysteresis band.
